name: Digital Signage Cost per Screen 2026: software cost at 1 to 250 screens
scope: Software subscription only, list prices, monthly billing; hardware, displays, installation, taxes, negotiated discounts, hosting and admin time excluded.

vendors.free_tier: permanent (3 screens free forever, no branding)
vendors.player_platforms: Windows, Mac, Android, Chrome OS, Raspberry Pi, iPad, browser
vendors.assumptions: Plus+ list rate $3 per screen per month for screens beyond the free 3; the public calculator applies volume pricing, so the figure is an upper bound.

vendors.free_tier: trial only for new accounts (30 days, up to 5 screens); the free single screen applies only while an account has exactly 1 screen
vendors.assumptions: Basic tier $8 per screen per month, raised Apr 1, 2026; Premium $12, Enterprise $16.

vendors.free_tier: permanent, 3 screens, with OptiSigns branding and limited storage
vendors.assumptions: Standard tier $10 per screen per month bills every screen once you leave the free plan; Engage $30.
Core from $20 per screen per month; higher tiers on quote.
About $18 to $20 per screen per month list.
About $11 per display per month list; education discounts advertised.

vendors.player_platforms: Raspberry Pi, Android TV, Amazon Signage Stick, Fire TV, Linux; browser PWA on Windows, macOS, Chrome OS
vendors.assumptions: Each new player $35 for the first year, then $20 per year (about $1.67 per month) from the second year; 2 players free; over 50 screens the vendor quotes custom pricing, so larger figures are list arithmetic. Verified 2026-09-19.

vendors.free_tier: 10 screens as a 3-month trial with a watermark (not subtracted)
vendors.player_platforms: Amazon Signage Stick, Fire TV, Android and Android TV, Windows, Raspberry Pi, Linux, macOS, LG webOS
vendors.assumptions: Published 2026-09-19: Home Basic $52 per month covers 10 screens with no watermark, then $6.49 per screen per month from the 11th; Business Pro $520 per month for unlimited screens is used where cheaper (100 and 250 screens). Monthly billing only; the 3-month watermarked trial is not subtracted.

vendors.player_platforms: TV browser (Android TV, Google TV, LG webOS, Fire TV via Silk, any browser), Android TV APK
vendors.assumptions: Solo plan $5 per screen per month on yearly billing ($6 monthly) for every screen beyond the 1 free screen; Agency pricing for 25+ screens is not cheaper than Solo yearly. Verified 2026-09-19.

vendors.free_tier: unlimited, self-hosted server (Xibo Cloud is paid; commercial Android/webOS/Tizen players are licensed)
vendors.player_platforms: Windows and Linux players free; commercial players licensed
vendors.assumptions: Software $0; you supply and run the server, updates and security. Hosting and admin time are not in this table. Xibo Cloud, if you do not self-host, is $4.90 per display per month (Professional) including all players; self-hosted Android, webOS, Tizen and ChromeOS players are one-time licences ($28, $85, $85, $49).

vendors.free_tier: unlimited, open source, one install per Raspberry Pi
vendors.assumptions: Software $0; no central cloud dashboard, each Pi managed on its own.
